(* REQ: LANG-1751 LANG-1752 LANG-1753 LANG-1754 *) (* outer (* nested *) still a comment *) datatype shape = Circle of real | Rect of real * real fun area (Circle r) = 3.14 * r * r | area (Rect (w, h)) = w * h fun greet name times = let val text = "Hello, " ^ name ^ "!\n" in if times > 0 andalso true then print text else () end val x' = SOME 42 val c = #"x" structure S = struct val n = 0x1F end
